LOD-FLOOR-MAP-PANEL-002 — AUTHOR CLARIFICATION (2026-10-13)
Q/M and the VR map action open the existing minimap panel for an eligible Hero even without this physical floor’s shared map. With no discovered map, show “Map not found — find this floor’s map” inside the panel instead of all maze/layout/route/quadrant overlays. The panel remains up, spends personal Magic and enacts the existing map-up effects. Collecting a registered floor map reveals only its floor for the entire party and refreshes an already-open panel. Preserve zero-Magic forced close, player lifecycle/role rules, topology secrecy, entrance-accessible placement, globe/eye and pickup notice/ditty.
